hook.line: Every formal letter or email carries something with it: a CV, an invoice, a signed contract. Spanish has a short, tidy way to say it is in the envelope.
hook.es: Adjunto les envío mi hoja de vida y dos cartas de referencia.
hook.en: I attach my CV and two letters of reference, for you all.

examples.es: Adjunto les envío mi hoja de vida y dos cartas de referencia.
examples.en: I attach my CV and two letters of reference, for you all.

examples.es: Adjunto le envío el contrato firmado.
examples.en: I attach the signed contract, for you (formal, one person).
You (formal) will find the report attached.

examples.es: Encontrará adjuntas las dos cartas de referencia.
examples.en: You (formal) will find the two letters of reference attached.
I attach the invoice, for you all.

rule:
To send a document with a formal message, put *adjunto* (attached) before the verb: *Adjunto les envío…* is "I attach and send you…".

*Le* is one person you address as *usted*. *Les* is several people, or a company.

To point to the document, say *Encontrará adjunto…* ("You will find… attached"). Here *adjunto* behaves like an adjective, so it agrees: *adjunto, adjunta, adjuntos, adjuntas*.

In Colombia a CV is *la hoja de vida*.
smallPrint: In *Adjunto les envío*, *adjunto* is a verb form: "I attach". After *encontrará* and *va*, it is an adjective, and agrees with what is attached.

yourTurn.prompt: Choose *le* or *les*. You write to one manager, *usted*: Adjunto ___ envío mi hoja de vida. Type the whole sentence.
yourTurn.answer: Adjunto le envío mi hoja de vida.

yourTurn.prompt: Choose *adjunto* or *adjuntos*: Encontrará ___ los documentos. Type the whole sentence.
I attach my CV and two letters of reference. (You write to a company, so *you all*.)
yourTurn.answer: Adjunto les envío mi hoja de vida y dos cartas de referencia.
accept: Adjunto les mando mi hoja de vida y dos cartas de referencia.
yourTurn.why: A company is several people, so *les*.

yourTurn.prompt: You (formal) will find the report attached.
yourTurn.why: *Encontrará adjunto* points to the document, and *adjunto* matches *el informe*.

yourTurn.prompt: I attach the signed contract, for you (formal, one person).
yourTurn.answer: Adjunto le envío el contrato firmado.
yourTurn.why: One person, so *le*, and *firmado* matches *el contrato*.

yourTurn.prompt: Make it plural: Encontrará adjunto el informe.
Now write to several people: Adjunto le envío la factura.

pitfalls.wrong: Encontrará adjunto las dos cartas de referencia.
pitfalls.right: Encontrará adjuntas las dos cartas de referencia.
pitfalls.why: Almost. In this frame *adjunto* is an adjective, so it matches *las cartas*.

pitfalls.wrong: Adjunto le envío mi hoja de vida. (to a whole company)
pitfalls.right: Adjunto les envío mi hoja de vida.
pitfalls.why: Almost. A company is several people, so the Spanish says *les*.

pitfalls.right: Adjunto les envío mi hoja de vida.
pitfalls.why: Almost. It is understood, but in Colombia a CV is a *hoja de vida*.
